title: Asteroid Resource Industrial Web - Technology Profile
description: Public edition: Connects prospecting, extraction, refining, transport, and orbital construction.
body:
Asteroid Resource Industrial Web. Connects prospecting, extraction, refining, transport, and orbital construction.

This database covers the technology as item 216 entry 67 of Manon's "100 Technologies Beyond Omega (B)" catalog, section "Stellar and Interstellar Expansion". It is the public edition: every factual claim below is drawn from real public science and engineering, honestly labeled.

Feasibility tier: theoretically plausible. Prospecting is real; extraction through construction is unproven.

Classification: public database. This record profiles the technology; companion records cover known science, constraints, approaches, tools, unresolved problems, evidence, and outlook.

title: Asteroid Resource Industrial Web - Physical and Engineering Constraints
description: Public edition: Connects prospecting, extraction, refining, transport, and orbital construction.
body:
Physical and engineering constraints on Asteroid Resource Industrial Web.

No extraction has occurred. Each link is pre-commercial. Web economics unproven.

Scale analysis across 3 quantities spans 6.3 orders of magnitude; the dominant scale separation is prospected vs mined at 6.3 orders of magnitude (prospected larger). Scale gaps this wide are the central engineering fact about this technology.
